tasks.label: Setup ROS Sim (WSL)
args: set -eo pipefail; cd "$(wslpath '${workspaceFolder}')/ros_ws"; source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash; if [ ! -f install/setup.bash ] || [ ! -f .ui_ros_build.stamp ] || find src -type f -newer .ui_ros_build.stamp | grep -q .; then echo '[setup_ros_sim] Changes detected or first run: building ROS packages...'; colcon build --packages-select uav_interfaces uav_sim; touch .ui_ros_build.stamp; else echo '[setup_ros_sim] No ROS source changes detected: skipping colcon build.'; fi

tasks.label: Run ROS Sim
args: set -eo pipefail; pkill -9 -x gazebo >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; pkill -9 -x gzserver >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; pkill -9 -x gzclient >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; pkill -9 -x gz >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; pkill -9 -x rviz2 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fuser -k 11345/tcp >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; cd "$(wslpath '${workspaceFolder}')/ros_ws"; source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash; source install/setup.bash; ros2 launch uav_sim sim_crazyflie_visual.launch.py

tasks.label: Run ROS Sim (Manual Topic Control)
args: set -eo pipefail; pkill -9 -x gazebo >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; pkill -9 -x gzserver >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; pkill -9 -x gzclient >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; pkill -9 -x gz >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; pkill -9 -x rviz2 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fuser -k 11345/tcp >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; cd "$(wslpath '${workspaceFolder}')/ros_ws"; source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash; source install/setup.bash; ros2 launch uav_sim sim_crazyflie_visual.launch.py autopilot_enabled:=false

tasks.label: Stop ROS Sim
args: pkill -9 -x gazebo >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; pkill -9 -x gzserver >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; pkill -9 -x gzclient >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; pkill -9 -x gz >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; pkill -9 -x rviz2 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fuser -k 11345/tcp >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; echo '[stop_ros_sim] Cleanup complete.'

tasks.label: Install Python Requirements
args: $venv = '.venv'; if (-not (Get-Command py -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { throw 'Python launcher (py) not found on PATH.' }; if (-not (Test-Path $venv)) { py -3.11 -m venv $venv }; $pyExe = Join-Path $venv 'Scripts\python.exe'; if (-not (Test-Path $pyExe)) { throw 'Virtual environment python not found.' }; & $pyExe -m pip install --upgrade pip; & $pyExe -m pip install -r requirements.txt

tasks.label: Run UI
args: $pyExe = '.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe'; if (-not (Test-Path $pyExe)) { throw 'Virtual environment python not found. Run the Install Python Requirements task first.' }; & $pyExe ui\app.py
